name: Death by Begonia
source:
After a ten-year absence, Riley Airhart returns to their hometown of Begonia, Arkansas and meets up with old friends, only to find that a serial killer has been plaguing the town ever since Riley disappeared.

[From [url=https://papermoonstudios.itch.io/death-by-begonia-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阔别十年后，莱利·艾尔哈特回到家乡阿肯色州贝海棠，与老朋友见面，却发现自从莱利失踪后，连环杀手就一直困扰着这个小镇。

[来自[url=https://papermoonstudios.itch.io/death-by-begonia-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
